metadata.title: [CHORE]: Update dependencies across Python, Go, and Rust projects
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Bump all Python dependencies to latest versions across 12 `pyproject.toml` files and 4 `requirements.txt` files using `update_dependencies.py`
- Update Go modules (`go get -u && go mod tidy`) for 4 Go projects: a2a-echo-agent, benchmark-server, fast-time-server, slow-time-server
- Update Rust lock files (`cargo update`) for 4 Rust projects: fast-test-server, filesystem-server, plugins_rust workspace, tools_rust/wrapper

### Notable version bumps
| Package | From | To |
|---------|------|----|
| mcp-go | v0.44.0 | v0.44.1 |
| a2a-go | pre-release | v0.3.7 |
| ruff | 0.15.1/0.15.2 | 0.15.4 |
| openai | 2.23.0 | 2.24.0 |
| anthropic | 0.83.0 | 0.84.0 |
| boto3/botocore | 1.42.55 | 1.42.58 |
| sqlalchemy | 2.0.46 | 2.0.47 |
| faker | 40.4.0 | 40.5.1 |
| redis | 7.2.0 | 7.2.1 |
| rustls | 0.23.36 | 0.23.37 |
| aws-lc-rs | 1.15.4 | 1.16.0 |

All Go and Rust projects verified to build cleanly after update.

## Test plan
- [ ] CI passes for all Python linting and tests
- [ ] Go projects build successfully
- [ ] Rust projects build successfully

commits.message:
fix(deps): resolve grpcio/protobuf version conflict breaking CI

grpcio-reflection 1.78.x caps protobuf at <7.0.0, making the
protobuf>=7.34.0 pin unsatisfiable during uv resolution for Python 3.13.
Lower the floor to >=6.31.1 (grpcio-reflection's own lower bound) until
the grpcio ecosystem releases builds that support protobuf 7.x.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
